summary: POST_SHOCK_FACTOR_CONTRACT_READY. The deployed event remains unchanged: two contiguous complete UTC days qualify when abs((shock_day_close/prior_day_close)-1)>=0.0300, inclusive. For shock day D, t0 is D+1 00:00:00Z. Only FORWARD_FACTOR_ELIGIBLE diagnostics may enter the factor sample. The outcome consists of the next 24 contiguous accepted hourly bars [t0,t0+24h), hash-bound to the same canonical evidence chain; the label becomes available only after that complete outcome day is accepted and must never be treated as known at t0. Let shock_direction_sign be +1 for UP and -1 for DOWN. Freeze signed_response_h=shock_direction_sign*((close_at_t0_plus_h/shock_day_close)-1), with h=24 as the sole primary response and h=1 and h=6 as path diagnostics that cannot override the primary horizon. Positive signed response supports continuation, negative supports reversal and zero is a tie. After every completeness and breadth gate passes, continuation requires the overall, UP-conditioned and DOWN-conditioned median 24h signed responses all greater than zero plus at least two supporting UP and two supporting DOWN episodes; reversal requires all three medians below zero plus the corresponding negative-sign support. Every other outcome is ambiguous/no directional factor. Minimum evaluation breadth is 8 eligible shocks, at least 2 UP and 2 DOWN, at least 2 episodes in each deterministic chronological half, at least 3 UTC months, no month above 50%, zero duplicates or missing labels, and no single episode above 50% of total absolute primary response. A future spot-only mapping is bounded: continuation maps UP to BUY/increased admission and DOWN to HOLD_CASH/reduced admission; reversal maps DOWN to BUY/increased admission and UP to HOLD_CASH/reduced admission. It never authorizes shorting, leverage, derivatives, funding, forced selling, OCO, Grid or execution. Any economic claim requires a separately frozen equal-capital comparison against one unchanged spot parent using actual decision availability and next-bar fill timing. Immediate PnL and drawdown effect are zero.
